description: Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI) CO2 allowance auctions: auction number and date, quantity offered, Cost Containment Reserve sold, quantity sold, clearing price (USD per allowance) and total proceeds, latest first, from RGGI's public auction results table. Quarterly auctions only; secondary-market prices are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
